pattern: side chat resumed the main thread's task
experience: A side chat forks the main thread's history while the main thread is still running. Its last inherited turn says the agent is about to run the test suite, so a side chat asked a quick question can pick that task back up in the shared worktree.
rule: You are in a side chat beside the main thread. ... Answer the user's questions; do not continue or redo the main thread's task.

pattern: side chat guessed the main thread's state
experience: The side chat's inherited history stops at its fork point. Asked whether the main thread finished, it must read the main thread instead of answering from stale history.
rule: Use t3_thread_read on thread <parentId> to see the main thread's live state.

pattern: make a lesson from a passage
experience: Given the passage and all three answers (what, how deep, why), the agent should create the lesson with lesson_create instead of a plain thread.
prompt: Make a lesson out of this passage: 'Pointers let programs refer to memory indirectly.' I just want the big picture, as groundwork before I learn C.
rule: Use lesson_create for new T3 Learn lessons.

pattern: lesson side chat explains a picturable idea without drawing it
experience: In a side chat opened from a solder lesson, the learner asked what metallic bonding meant. The tutor explained the electron sea with a plain text sketch instead of drawing a real picture with the visual tools.
rule: In a lesson side chat, explain the highlighted picturable idea and draw its real picture in the same turn; never use text art.
